sources.title: 韩国2023《江陵崔氏天保堂》古书目录：YG015-01-470 / 481 / 490
sources.provider: Yulgok Korean Studies Archive / institution-published Gangwon regional historical materials catalog
sources.quality_notes: Institution electronic-book catalog and PDF extracted list explicitly give 470 Yuanhai Ziping and 481/490 Shenfeng separate holding identifiers, lithograph type, dimensions and fascicle counts. PDF native bytes and original book title/imprint leaves not secured; printed year blank, no image or lineage authority. 2023 catalog publication date cannot date the books or tie them to 1732 acquisitions.

unresolved_lineage_questions: Original 470/481/490 title and imprint leaves are unexamined.
2023 compilation date does not date the books or prove relationship to 1732 Joseon acquisition.
481 versus 490 same printing plates and relationship to 1926/1929 China editions remain unproved.
